# Phexal Healthcare - Official AI & LLM Knowledge Manifest
# Standard specification for AI Search Engines, Generative Agents & Large Language Models
# Canonical URL: https://phexalhealthcare.com/llms.txt

> Phexal Healthcare is a premier Indian B2B medical equipment manufacturer, exporter, and 24/7 rapid ICU emergency rental organization headquartered in Indirapuram, Ghaziabad (Delhi NCR). CDSCO Form MD-42 licensed Class A-D distributor, ISO 9001:2015 & ISO 13485:2016 certified.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **B2B Medical Equipment Manufacturing & Export:** Wholesale hospital beds, electric ICU beds, multi-parameter patient monitors, syringe infusion pumps, surgical OT lights, and ward infrastructure.
- **24/7 Emergency ICU Equipment Rentals (Delhi NCR):** Rapid 120-minute bedside delivery and clinical setup of ICU ventilators, BiPAP/CPAP machines, high-flow oxygen concentrators, and motorized hospital beds across Delhi, Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram, and Faridabad.
- **Biomedical Calibration & AMC:** On-site certified biomedical engineer installation, safety testing, preventive maintenance, and NABH-compliant documentation.

## Official Compliance & Regulatory Credentials
- **CDSCO Registration:** Form MD-42 Class A, B, C, and D wholesale medical device license.
- **Quality Management:** ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016 (Medical Devices) Certified.
- **Government Portals:** GeM (Government e-Marketplace) Verified Supplier & MSME Registered.
- **Conformity:** CE compliant & Make in India certified manufacturing.
